## `static`

For a variable at block scope, `static` gives it static storage duration — it is initialized once and persists for the lifetime of the program. For a variable or function at file scope, `static` gives it internal linkage — it is not visible outside the translation unit.

For a `static inline` function, GCC will not emit object code for the function unless it is needed; all calls will be inlined if possible.
